subject: planner: fix wrong TopN's ByItem with expression.ScalarFunction when to PushDownTopN (#60822)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent with focus on planner/executor behavior. The only runtime-impacting change is `pkg/planner/core/operator/logicalop/logical_projection.go` `LogicalProjection.PushDownTopN`: it now checks (on the substituted order-by expressions) for projection-generated columns that would block pushdown *before* mutating `topN.ByItems`, preventing a TopN that stays above the projection from ending up with rewritten/invalid ByItems (especially when substitutions introduce `expression.ScalarFunction`). This is a correctness-preserving change; no remaining plausible Blocker/High issues found. Later history up to `upstream-master` shows no subsequent fix specifically adjusting this PushDownTopN logic (only unrelated edits/refactors).
